description: Training courses (Step 18 LMS): workers list/enroll/take the auto-graded course quiz (transparent scores, Samigo-style randomized draws + attempt limits); buyers assemble the approved curriculum into a course, publish it, and require it for serving (workers must be CLEARED before the project serves them tasks). Requires learning:read / learning:write.

action.description: Worker actions: list_mine (my courses), enroll, start_quiz, submit_quiz (needs attemptId+answers). Buyer actions (need projectId + ownership): project_course (read course + completions), assemble (from the approved curriculum), publish/unpublish, require/unrequire (serving gate).

answers.description: submit_quiz: map of questionId -> answer (option index).

name: opentrain_learning_courses
